# Candy Apples

Candy Apples is the mint-green Earth pony with a red mane tied into pigtails with yellow bows, amber-toned eyes, and a candy apple and caramel apple cutie mark. She is an extended Apple family member, identified as Granny Smith's second cousin. Think of her as the candy-apple cousin who helps out at family gatherings and community events.

[![Candy Apples carrying a pie, Friendship is Magic, Hasbro/DHX Media](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/20/1705505__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_bandana%2Bbaldwin_candy%2Bapples_high%2Bstakes_jade%2Bspade_prairie%2Bbelle_earth%2Bpony_pony_the%2Bsummer%2Bsun%2Bsetback_appl.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/1705505)

- **Name:** Candy Apples is a licensed name, not merely a fandom nickname. The [character wiki](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Candy_Apples) records her addition to Gameloft's game on October 6, 2014, and an October 2014 promotional post using the singular Candy Apple. Hasbro's [2015 Wave 13 blind bags](https://www.mlpmerch.com/2015/06/wave-13-blind-bag-codes-found.html) use Candy Apples. The original promotional post was not independently retrieved.
- **Speaking status:** No confirmed individual dialogue or voice actor; she participates in ensemble scenes.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in Apple Family Reunion (2012); also appears in Appleoosa's Most Wanted, The Perfect Pear and The Summer Sun Setback, where she helps cater the celebration. The character wiki also identifies her in Applejack's nightmare in IDW's Friendship is Magic #5, p. 7 (comic continuity). In the [licensed mobile game](https://all-the-ponies.com/en/pony/Pony_Candy_Apples/), she lives at Sweet Apple Acres and loves sweet, sticky treats.

## Important moments

- **Rebuilding the barn** — [Apple Family Reunion (S3E8)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/apple-family-reunion/umc.cmc.6v8fw3qa69w1rwnv0fwrcc8cs?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j). She joins the family in rebuilding the ruined barn, helping turn a disastrous reunion into an exercise in cooperation. Timestamp unavailable.
- **Rodeo teammate** — [Appleoosa's Most Wanted (S5E6)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/appleoosas-most-wanted/umc.cmc.563l8a8nsbtf4axuyat2pclg4?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j). She competes alongside Applejack, Bushel, Florina Tart and Apple Cinnamon in hay-bale stacking. Timestamp unavailable.
- **A glimpse of her childhood** — [The Perfect Pear (S7E13)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165201/s07-e13-the-perfect-pear). She appears as a filly during Pear Butter's song, placing her in the earlier generation of Apple family history. Timestamp unavailable.
